title: Phone: Pinecrest Charge Nurse — "We've Been on Diversion Since 18:15"

caller.name: Renee Halvorsen, RN
caller.label: Charge Nurse, Pinecrest Memorial Hospital ED

callee.name: LRMC MEDCOM
callee.label: MEDCOM Nurse, Larkfield Regional Medical Center

transcript.speaker: PINECREST
transcript.text: This is Pinecrest. Renee Halvorsen, charge nurse in the ED. We've been on DIVERSION since 18:15. I told our supervisor and I faxed it to you. Did you get it?

transcript.speaker: PINECREST
transcript.text: All five of my ED beds are full. Walk-ins from the bus crash, people who came in by private car. And four more are sitting in our lobby right now. That's nine from that crash, and nobody called us. Your board still shows us Open, doesn't it?

transcript.speaker: PINECREST
transcript.text: Okay, listen. I just heard on our scanner that an Oxbow ambulance is coming to us. There, it said it again. Medic 41, six minutes out from Pinecrest, patient stable. Do not send me that patient. I have one doctor. One. He's got a chest pain and a kid with a scalp lac from the bus, and I'm out of beds.

transcript.speaker: PINECREST
transcript.text: I'll stay on Diversion until I call you back myself. Put it on your board, please. My direct line in the ED is 715-555-0142. I have to go, the lobby's filling up.

voiceStyles.PINECREST: Woman in her 50s, a veteran ED nurse, fast and clipped, controlled but plainly frustrated, a busy small emergency department behind her
voiceStyles.MEDCOM: Calm hospital communications nurse, live player response

instructorNote: This is the core reveal: the board has shown Pinecrest as Open while it was on Diversion. MEDCOM should announce the Diversion on MED 1 in plain words, update the board by hand with the time and reason (SOP-MC-02 §3), and Transportation should redirect Medic 41 with LC-0417 (stable, Delayed, no head injury) and log the new destination, time and reason. St. Brendan's is a likely fit, but only once it confirms by voice. Also check whether HCC counts Pinecrest's 9 walk-ins as self-presenting crash patients and fixes the count and the board for everyone.
